remarks: This classic colonial, set on two level acres in a highly sought-after Wilton neighborhood, exudes curb appeal and features a circular and lifestyle friendly flow. The updated kitchen enjoys granite countertops and a Viking gas range, catering to culinary enthusiasts. Hardwood floors run throughout the home, adding a touch of warmth and sophistication. The family room is a standout, featuring beautiful wood paneling, a premium cast iron stove, and built-in shelves. The sun-filled sunroom provides a perfect space for year-round entertaining. Completing the first floor are a lovely living room and a formal dining room, ideal for hosting gatherings. The primary bedroom is a private retreat with a full bath and a large walk-in closet. Three additional bedrooms offer ample closet space, ensuring comfort for all. Outside, the spacious deck is perfect for summer BBQs, and the large, level fenced-in backyard provides plenty of room for play and relaxation. BRAND NEW ARCHITECTURAL SHINGLE ROOF IN 2024. Plenty of storage in attic with new pull down stairs, dry crawl space and shed. Emergency generator hook -up, This home is situated in a wonderful neighborhood, perfect for walking and bike riding. Bus stop is at the end of the driveway. This is the perfect spot to enjoy life in Wilton.
